d: On the last day of chhath puja at the break of dawn, we ventured towards the ghat, eagerly looking forward to experiencing the sacred rituals of Bhoriya argh. The was alive with devotion as families, clad in their finest attire, arrived laden with offerings. Spirits were high as everyone eagerly awaited the rising sun, armed with prayers and offerings. As rays of the sun began to appear in the horizon, the fasting women, including Svaita ji, immersed themselves in the river waters to perform the bhoriya argh and other rites.
